detours.why: Cook Hall's mapped door is on its south side, facing the Technological Institute, so walks from Sargent Hall to the north go round the building.
City block: the Anthropology Department's house faces the next street over from Hinman's door, with houses and yards between and no mapped path through, so walks go round the block.
